title: eludite.search.results input
description: Read a Find Results window's results, a page at a time, or (by `search_id`) one of the last searches' results whether or not a window shows them. With `navigate` or `select`, move the window's selection as F8, Shift+F8, Replace in Files' Skip File and a double-click on a result do: the window selects the match and the editor opens at it, with the match selected. With `clear`, empty the window (its Clear button).

results_window.description: Find Results 1 or 2. Default: the one that showed the last search.

search_id.description: A search of the last 16 (from eludite.search.find), instead of a window.

offset.description: The first match to return, 0-based over every match in the window's order (default 0).

navigate.description: F8 (`next`), Shift+F8 (`previous`), or Replace in Files' Skip File (`next_file`: the first match of the next file): move the window's selection and open the editor at that match. The answer's `selected` is it.

select.description: Select the match at this offset (over every match in the window's order) and open the editor at it, as a double-click on the result does.

clear.description: Empty the window (Clear All); a running search in it is stopped.
